hypotheses: The bounded provider-proxy error mode caused API chat requests to return server errors above the anomaly band.
API pod failure did not cause the burst because the API and proxy deployments each remained available.

falsifying_checks.check: Compare error ratio, upper band and request-volume guard.
falsifying_checks.result: Error ratio was 1, upper band was 0.015 and volume was 32.23198631126321 requests per five minutes.

falsifying_checks.check: Inspect Kubernetes availability and restore normal proxy mode.
falsifying_checks.result: API and proxy each had one available replica; the alert resolved after proxy mode returned to normal.

root_cause.observed: The controlled proxy returned HTTP 503 before calling the external provider, and the API surfaced 30 HTTP 502 responses.
root_cause.inferred: The injected upstream failure caused the server-error burst.
root_cause.unknown: The controlled local failure does not identify any production-provider defect.

actions: Restored provider fault mode to normal.
Confirmed the Prometheus alert became inactive and Slack emitted RESOLVED.
Confirmed a post-recovery browser chat returned the expected answer, citation and 3700 ms latency.
